summary: Adds nats_request() wrapper (tacticalrmm/nats_utils.py) that turns NATS NoRespondersError (agent not connected) into a normal timeout, used by Agent.nats_cmd, a_nats_cmd and the orphaned-task cleanup; actions on disconnected agents (ping, commands, bulk/orphan cleanup) now report 'timeout'/'offline' instead of crashing with a 500, but deliberately wait out the full timeout first.

statements.why: Error-handling fix only; no permission or data changes.

statements.text: • The agent also changed api/tacticalrmm/autotasks/tasks.py and api/tacticalrmm/tacticalrmm/nats_utils.py.
statements.why: True, but omits agents/models.py (Agent.nats_cmd), which is the main user-facing path, and explains nothing.

misses.what: Talking to a disconnected agent (ping, run command, etc.) no longer shows a server error (500); it reports the agent as offline/timed out, and bulk jobs keep other agents' results instead of failing entirely.
Those requests now wait the full timeout before answering (nats_utils.py:44-53 sleeps out the remaining time), so actions on offline agents are slower than the previous immediate failure.
